mentions.name: Linux from Scratch-style bioinformatics explanations
mentions.description: A Linux from Scratch-style resource for bioinformatics-centric software that provides full, useful explanations of the underlying components for non-tech-savvy people — covering not just how to use the tools but how they work, with explanations that are not too technical and not overly long.
mentions.problem: Most bioinformatics software was written by math-heavy tech-centric people, making it non-trivial to work with, and many people using AI to work around this don't understand the underlying components.
mentions.source_excerpt: continue working with regard to bioinformatics, also with a focus on normal people (non-tech savvy people). Most bioinformatics software was written by math-heavy tech-centric people, which makes sense. It's not trivial to work with that (we have AI to work around this to some extent, but I feel that many people who use AI don't understand the underlying components; I kind of want something like a Linux from Scratch for all bioinformatics-centric software. Like not just use it but full and useful explanations that are not too technical, but also not too overly long.)
